Feel The Force Flowing Through You: [Set 14] Rey and characters with her may not add battle destiny draws. Rey, The Force Will Be With You, Always: [Set 14] Rey ignores your [Episode VII] objective deployment restrictions.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Be With Me (Errata)]]): Card image published 20 February 2023<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/bewithme.gif</code> as published 20 February 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9e3d9929eb170ded7c439b48f806e67eb656faf7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/bewithme.gif holotable commit 9e3d992] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on an Ahch-To location. Bring Back The Balance, Rey, As I Did: While [Set 14] Rey in battle, your battle destiny draws and Rey's weapon destiny draws are +1. Feel The Force Flowing Through You: [Set 14] Rey and characters with her may not add battle destiny draws. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Be With Me (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 9 March 2026, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set17Type.html Virtual Set 17 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/bewithme.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/bewithme.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If an Ahch-To location on table, deploy on table. A Thousand Generations Live In You Now: Rey is power and forfeit +1 for each Jedi on table or out of play. Bring Back The Balance, Rey, As I Did: While Rey in battle, your battle destiny draws and Rey's weapon destiny draws are +1. Feel The Force Flowing Through You: Rey and characters with her may not add battle destiny draws. Rey, The Force Will Be With You, Always: Unless Rey is on Jakku, she adds 1 to your total Force generation.” '''What changed:''' Game text: “Deploy on” became “If”; “location. Opponent generates no Force here.” became “location on table, deploy on table.”; “on table or” was added; “[Set 14]” was removed; “[Set 14]” was removed; “[Set 14]” became “Unless”; “ignores” became “is on Jakku, she adds 1 to”; “[Episode VII] objective deployment restrictions.” became “total Force generation.”
